review: I had a very enjoyable day with Alan and 2 other students in his Woodland Masterclass. He taught us a lot about how to look for and take good images in woodlands. The three of us ranged from beginners to more experienced and he took care to ensure that the post-processing demonstration was helpful to all three of us.

We had a fabulous day of photography in Padley Gorge and Boleshill Quarry. Alan was a great tutor - incredibly patient and informative. I learnt a lot in a short space of time and it was great to be able to put that learning into practice in a stunning location. Alan had a brilliant knowledge of the area and helped us to ‘see’ the opportunities first and foremost before looking at the technical. A brilliant day -,Alan looked after us from beginning to end and made sure we each got the most out of the session. Thank you!

Great day on the Peaks photography workshop. Alan was brilliant, took time to work with us all individually and so pleased with the skills and shots I came away with. The smaller group size was a huge bonus too. Highly recommend!
Fantastic photography workshop in the Peaks today. Came away with a lot more creative vision and understanding.

I very much enjoyed Alan Ranger’s residential photography weekend in North Wales, having picked up my camera again after a gap of around 20 years! Alan adapts his teaching style to suit my level of knowledge, making the experience both enjoyable and incredibly informative. I learnt a great deal and came away with a new appreciation of photography as a creative art form, rather than simply taking pictures.  The weekend was engaging, inspiring and full of learning opportunities, with Alan’s great sense of humour an added bonus. I would highly recommend Alan to everyone, from complete beginners to experienced photographers. A fantastic experience!
Had a 1-1 session, found it very informative and tailored to my needs. Alan went through the fundamentals to get me off to a good start
Very knowledgeable. Clear explanation for someone who knows absolutely nothing.
Excellent service. Had sensor and mirror cleaned, which given the results wished I’d had done years ago.
